summary: Frontend-only payments iteration verified on localhost:3000. All client-side wiring confirmed: Stripe publishable key is loaded (no 'Stripe not configured' banner on player Payments page), 'Pay with Stripe' invokes supabase.functions POST to /functions/v1/create-checkout-session, and when the edge function is undeployed the UI cleanly surfaces 'Failed to send a request to the Edge Function' (no silent failure). Manager Payments view renders the purchase-history-panel with heading 'Stripe purchase history' and empty state (SQL migration + edge functions not yet deployed by user, per PAYMENTS_SETUP.md). Supabase realtime websocket connection opens on manager dashboard. TypeScript project build passes (exit 0). Source-code checks confirm create-checkout-session/index.ts intentionally omits payment_method_types and sets payment_method_options.card.request_three_d_secure = 'automatic' (so Google Pay + Apple Pay wallets auto-enable on Stripe Checkout).

integration_issues.issue: Edge function create-checkout-session returns preflight failure (not deployed yet). User must deploy per /app/app/PAYMENTS_SETUP.md. UI correctly surfaces the error to the user.

purchases table missing in Supabase schema (console: 'Could not find the table public.purchases in the schema cache'). User must run supabase/purchases-refund.sql migration. Panel gracefully shows empty state.

verified_checks.error_banner_visible_on_failure: Failed to send a request to the Edge Function
verified_checks.empty_state_message: No activity yet / Membership fees and store purchases appear here.

action_items: USER ACTION: run supabase/purchases-refund.sql migration in Supabase SQL editor (adds 'refunded' status + audit columns; also creates purchases table if missing).
USER ACTION: deploy edge functions create-checkout-session + refund-checkout-session (and stripe-webhook) via Supabase CLI. See /app/app/PAYMENTS_SETUP.md.
USER ACTION: register Stripe webhook endpoint pointing at deployed stripe-webhook function.

After the above, the full happy path (checkout → paid row appears → refund button → refund confirmed) can be re-tested end-to-end. Refund button + refunded-tag rendering was not exercisable in this iteration because no paid rows exist.
critical_code_review_comments: ManagerDashboard.tsx is very large (>4500 lines); PurchaseHistoryPanel around line 4515 should probably be extracted into its own component file for maintainability.

Player payments error banner uses raw message 'Failed to send a request to the Edge Function' — consider wrapping with friendlier copy like 'Payments are temporarily unavailable. Please contact your club.' for production polish.

Console shows repeated 'Could not find the table public.purchases in the schema cache' warnings — client should degrade silently on 42P01/PGRST205 errors so managers/players don't see noisy warnings in the console once table is created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full end-to-end payment + refund flow can only be tested after the USER manually (a) runs supabase/purchases-refund.sql, (b) deploys the 3 edge functions via `supabase functions deploy`, and (c) configures the Stripe webhook. Localhost:3000 is authoritative (external preview URL was flaky). Manager login lands on Payments via left nav; 'Stripe purchase history' panel is on Payments page. Player 'Pay with Stripe' button is on My Payments page. TS build via `cd /app/app && npx tsc -b` passes.
rca of the issue: Not a code bug — remaining Stripe setup requires Supabase project-side steps (SQL + edge function deploy + webhook) that cannot be performed from within this pod (no Supabase CLI + admin access token). Frontend + edge function source code + client wiring all verified correct. Once user completes /app/app/PAYMENTS_SETUP.md steps, checkout, purchase-history population, and refund flow should work.
